eyebrow.zh: 更少文件 · 更短输出 · 更小爆炸半径 · 动手前先点头
eyebrow.en: Fewer files · Less output · Smaller blast · Accept before it runs

headline.zh:
Agent 想写 14 个文件？
先只让它写 4 个
headline.en:
Agent wanted 14 files?
Let it write 4 first

sub.zh: ScopeReflex 读你代理的计划，写出一个文件更少、输出更短的版本，并在它动手前把前后对比的数字摆到你面前等你点头。
sub.en: ScopeReflex reads your agent's plan, writes a smaller one with fewer files and less output, and lays the before→after counts in front of you to accept before it runs.

title.zh: 批准前，先看清裁掉了多少
title.en: See the trim before you approve

body.zh: 代理一交出计划，ScopeReflex 就在旁边摆好一份更小的——文件、步骤、输出，逐项前后计数。你凭数字定范围，而不是凭“也许 14 个文件有点多”的感觉。
body.en: The moment your agent hands over a plan, ScopeReflex sets a smaller one beside it — files, steps, and output, each counted before→after. You decide scope on numbers, not on a feeling that maybe 14 files is too many.

chips: › 文件、步骤、输出——前后对比

title.zh: 接受、改、还是拒？每份计划都你说了算
title.en: Accept, edit, or reject — your call, every plan

body.zh: 在代理碰任何文件之前，收缩后的计划停在一道你掌控的提示后。照单全收、挑哪些文件留下、还是直接拒——只有你点头，才会把更小的计划写回去交给代理执行。
body.en: Before the agent touches a file, the trimmed plan waits behind a prompt you control. Accept it whole, pick which files survive, or throw it out — only your accept writes the smaller plan back for the agent to run.

chips: › 改的是裁剪，不是整份计划
› 接受才写出更小的计划

title.zh: 可选的文件和步骤？默认就砍掉
title.en: Optional files and steps? Gone by default

body.zh: 代理标记成可选的，自动砍掉；散落的辅助文件折回到隔壁那一个里。关键路径留着，那些凑数的根本到不了真正跑的那份计划。
body.en: Anything the agent marked optional is trimmed automatically, and scattered helper files fold back into the one beside them. The critical path stays; the padding never reaches the plan that actually runs.

title.zh: 没守护进程，没 key，没配置文件
title.en: No daemon, no key, no config

body.zh: 一个 CLI。把代理的计划用 JSON 或 markdown 喂进去，拿回更小的 JSON 计划——直接管道给你已经在跑的任何 harness。不用额外装东西，也没有后台嗡嗡作响。
body.en: One CLI. Feed it your agent's plan as JSON or markdown, get the smaller plan back as JSON — pipe it into whatever harness you already run. Nothing to install beside, nothing humming in the background.

headline.zh: 交出你代理本该提的那份 4 文件计划
headline.en: Ship the 4-file plan your agent should've proposed

sub.zh: 一份计划进，一份更小的计划出，你点头裁剪。开源，一条命令跑通。
sub.en: One plan in, a smaller plan out, you accept the trim. Open source, runs in one command.

tag.zh: 给过度生产的编码代理的“做更少”反射 · 开源 MIT
tag.en: The do-less reflex for over-producing coding agents · open source MIT
